export_controls.text: Third, as envisioned in the IRA, we must strengthen our supply chains and domestic production, particularly of advanced chips to lead in the artificial intelligence economy, and in the interest of our national security.

deepseek.reason: The statement promotes domestic chip production and supply-chain resilience, not export restrictions or enforcement.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The text addresses chip investment and national security without mentioning overseas access controls.

china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial intelligence represents the next major frontier in U.S.-China competition. Winning that race will not come from bluster or isolation but from sustained investment in research, talent and responsible governance. The United States should lead in setting global standards for AI that protect civil liberties, prevent misuse and ensure democratic values shape emerging technologies, rather than allowing authoritarian models to dominate.

deepseek.reason: The speaker frames AI as the next major frontier in U.S.-China competition and says the United States should lead in setting global standards.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names U.S.-China competition and endorses responsible governance and standard-setting.
